title: Lawnmower
statementMd:
You have a garden consisting entirely of grass and weeds. Your garden is described by an $*n* × *m*$ grid, with rows numbered $1$ to $*n*$ from top to bottom, and columns $1$ to $*m*$ from left to right. Each cell is identified by a pair $(*r*, *c*)$ which means that the cell is located at row $*r*$ and column $*c*$. Each cell may contain either grass or weeds. For example, a $4 × 5$ garden may look as follows (empty cells denote grass):

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ac8d9023dd45a8d2bf447ae30b7392ba60273274.png)

You have a land-mower with you to mow all the weeds. Initially, you are standing with your lawnmower at the top-left corner of the garden. That is, at cell $(1, 1)$. At any moment of time you are facing a certain direction — either left or right. And initially, you face right.

In one move you can do either one of these:

1) Move one cell in the direction that you are facing.

- if you are facing right: move from cell $(*r*, *c*)$ to cell $(*r*, *c* + 1)$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1054e100cdeb897ba0302d96757cc48a65b862f2.png)
- if you are facing left: move from cell $(*r*, *c*)$ to cell $(*r*, *c* - 1)$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d54bd7dff77844e635a768561884e9ba3cc2693e.png)

2) Move one cell down (that is, from cell

(*r*, *c*)

to cell

(*r* + 1, *c*)

), and change your direction to the opposite one.

- if you were facing right previously, you will face left ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/44ff276945b3aa720c016e4b8010b1dcce6b305f.png)
- if you were facing left previously, you will face right ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0eda77c3f9484f9d2e28ba0e1590d5c0f4af2ead.png)

You are not allowed to leave the garden. Weeds will be mowed if you and your lawnmower are standing at the cell containing the weeds (your direction doesn't matter). This action isn't counted as a move.

What is the minimum number of moves required to mow all the weeds?

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 150$) — the number of rows and columns respectively. Then follow $*n*$ lines containing $*m*$ characters each — the content of the grid. "`G`" means that this cell contains grass. "`W`" means that this cell contains weeds.

It is guaranteed that the top-left corner of the grid will contain grass.

## Output

Print a single number — the minimum number of moves required to mow all the weeds.

## Note

For the first example, this is the picture of the initial state of the grid:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/54442a964aa30f8e0d2fd1ddf4b4361c1612ce0e.png)

A possible solution is by mowing the weeds as illustrated below:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dfb903698561095c2d456b5f9bfb0c0162053e31.png)
statementZhMd:
你有一个完全由草地和杂草组成的花园。花园由一个 $*n* × *m*$ 的网格表示，行从上到下编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$，列从左到右编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。每个单元格由一对 $(*r*, *c*)$ 标识，表示该单元格位于第 $*r*$ 行、第 $*c*$ 列。每个单元格中可能是草地或杂草。例如，一个 $4 × 5$ 的花园可能如下所示（空单元格表示草地）：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ac8d9023dd45a8d2bf447ae30b7392ba60273274.png)

你带着一台割草机，要割除所有杂草。开始时，你和割草机位于花园的左上角，也就是单元格 $(1, 1)$。在任意时刻，你都面向某个方向——左或右。初始时，你面向右方。

一次移动可以执行以下操作之一：

1) 沿当前面向的方向移动一个单元格。

- 如果你面向右方：从单元格 $(*r*, *c*)$ 移动到单元格 $(*r*, *c* + 1)$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1054e100cdeb897ba0302d96757cc48a65b862f2.png)
- 如果你面向左方：从单元格 $(*r*, *c*)$ 移动到单元格 $(*r*, *c* - 1)$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d54bd7dff77844e635a768561884e9ba3cc2693e.png)

2) 向下移动一个单元格（即从单元格

(*r*, *c*)

移动到单元格

(*r* + 1, *c*)

），并将面向的方向改变为相反方向。

- 如果之前面向右方，现在将面向左方 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/44ff276945b3aa720c016e4b8010b1dcce6b305f.png)
- 如果之前面向左方，现在将面向右方 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0eda77c3f9484f9d2e28ba0e1590d5c0f4af2ead.png)

不允许离开花园。当你和割草机位于含有杂草的单元格时，杂草就会被割除（你面向的方向无关紧要）。割除杂草不计入移动次数。

割除所有杂草所需的最少移动次数是多少？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 150$），分别表示行数和列数。接下来有 $*n*$ 行，每行包含 $*m*$ 个字符，表示网格的内容。`G` 表示该单元格是草地，`W` 表示该单元格中有杂草。

保证网格的左上角包含草地。

## 输出格式

输出一个数——割除所有杂草所需的最少移动次数。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/54442a964aa30f8e0d2fd1ddf4b4361c1612ce0.png)
